title: Men's Lineman – Bad Weather Is My Overtime Hoodie

seo.title: Lineman Hoodie – Bad Weather Is My Overtime
seo.description: A funny lineman hoodie for the guy who works the storms: BAD WEATHER IS MY OVERTIME. Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

BAD WEATHER IS MY OVERTIME. is the lineman hoodie for the guy who gets called out every time the wind picks up, worn to the truck at 3 a.m., the storm-restoration shift and the family cookout after.

BAD WEATHER runs across the top and IS MY OVERTIME. fills the bottom, even wider, in heavy serif capitals. Between them a grinning lineman in a hard hat and harness straddles a utility pole crossarm with a thumbs-up, rain slanting across the scene and a small lightning bolt in the corner.

Navy carries cream and mustard lettering with a cream edge around the scene; Sand gets navy and faded red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this hoodie warm enough for a cold storm shift?
Yes. The Bad Weather Is My Overtime hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer under a work jacket for cold call-outs, long restoration shifts and wet mornings.

How does the Bad Weather Is My Overtime hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk at all.

Is this a good gift for a lineman?
It is a natural one. Every lineman has been called out when the weather turns, so the joke lands with the crew, the family and the guy who is already packing the truck. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the lineman sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Bad Weather Is My Overtime hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
